original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application with security best practices

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment name (e.g., prod, staging)
    Default: prod
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID where the Aurora cluster will be deployed
  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of at least two private subnet IDs in distinct AZs for the DB subnet group
  AppSecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional security group ID of the application tier allowed to connect to the database
    Default: ''
  AllowedIngressCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional CIDR block allowed to access the database (e.g., for bastion). Leave blank to disable.
    Default: ''
  DBClusterIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Description: Aurora DB cluster identifier
    Default: saas-aurora-pg
  DBName:
    Type: String
    Description: Initial database name
    Default: appdb
  MasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Description: Master username (password will be auto-managed by RDS in Secrets Manager)
    Default: dbadmin
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 16
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*'
  EngineVersion:
    Type: String
    Description: Aurora PostgreSQL engine version that supports Serverless v2
    Default: '16.2'
  DBFamily:
    Type: String
    Description: Cluster parameter group family (must match engine major version)
    Default: aurora-postgresql16
    AllowedPattern: 'aurora-postgresql(11|12|13|14|15|16)'
  MinCapacityACU:
    Type: Number
    Description: Minimum ACUs for Serverless v2 (0.5 - 128, increments of 0.5)
    Default: 1.0
  MaxCapacityACU:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum ACUs for Serverless v2 (0.5 - 128, increments of 0.5)
    Default: 16.0
  BackupRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of days to retain automated backups
    Default: 14
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 35
  PreferredBackupWindow:
    Type: String
    Description: Preferred backup window (UTC) e.g., 03:00-04:00
    Default: 03:00-04:00
  PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
    Type: String
    Description: Preferred maintenance window (UTC) e.g., sun:04:00-sun:05:00
    Default: sun:04:00-sun:05:00
  PubliclyAccessible:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether the DB instances are publicly accessible (strongly recommended false)
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'false'
  DBPort:
    Type: Number
    Description: Database port
    Default: 5432
    MinValue: 1024
    MaxValue: 65535
  EnablePerformanceInsights:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable Performance Insights
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Description: Performance Insights retention in days (7, 31, 63, ... up to 731)
    Default: 31
    MinValue: 7
    MaxValue: 731
  EnableDeletionProtection:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable deletion protection on the cluster
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
  CreateReaderInstance:
    Type: String
    Description: Create a reader instance for high availability
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'

Conditions:
  HasAppSecurityGroup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AppSecurityGroupId, '']]
  HasAllowedIngressCidr: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AllowedIngressCidr, '']]
  PubliclyAccessibleTrue: !Equals [!Ref PubliclyAccessible, 'true']
  EnablePI: !Equals [!Ref EnablePerformanceInsights, 'true']
  DeletionProtectionTrue: !Equals [!Ref EnableDeletionProtection, 'true']
  CreateReaderInstanceCond: !Equals [!Ref CreateReaderInstance, 'true']

Resources:
  RDSKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for encrypting Aurora PostgreSQL cluster and Performance Insights
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowRDSUseOfTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub rds.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-kms-key
  RDSKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${EnvironmentName}/aurora-postgresql
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: !Sub Subnet group for ${EnvironmentName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-subnet-group

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub Security group for ${EnvironmentName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-sg

  SGIngressFromAppSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: HasAppSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref DBPort
      ToPort: !Ref DBPort
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroupId
      Description: Allow Postgres from application security group

  SGIngressFromCIDR:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: HasAllowedIngressCidr
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref DBPort
      ToPort: !Ref DBPort
      CidrIp: !Ref AllowedIngressCidr
      Description: Allow Postgres from specified CIDR

  DBClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Cluster parameter group for ${EnvironmentName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      Family: !Ref DBFamily
      Parameters:
        rds.force_ssl: '1'
        log_min_duration_statement: '2000'
        log_connections: '1'
        log_disconnections: '1'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-cluster-params

  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: !Ref EngineVersion
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBClusterIdentifier
      DatabaseName: !Ref DBName
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      Port: !Ref DBPort
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !Ref BackupRetentionPeriod
      PreferredBackupWindow: !Ref PreferredBackupWindow
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref DBClusterParameterGroup
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      DeletionProtection: !If [DeletionProtectionTrue, true, false]
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - postgresql
      IamDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled: true
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref MinCapacityACU
        MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxCapacityACU
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-cluster
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBInstanceWriter:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${DBClusterIdentifier}-writer
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      PubliclyAccessible: !If [PubliclyAccessibleTrue, true, false]
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      AllowMajorVersionUpgrade: false
      EnablePerformanceInsights: !If [EnablePI, true, false]
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !If [EnablePI, !Ref RDSKmsKey, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: !If [EnablePI, !Ref PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      PromotionTier: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-writer
        - Key: Role
          Value: writer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBInstanceReader:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Condition: CreateReaderInstanceCond
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${DBClusterIdentifier}-reader
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      PubliclyAccessible: !If [PubliclyAccessibleTrue, true, false]
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      AllowMajorVersionUpgrade: false
      EnablePerformanceInsights: !If [EnablePI, true, false]
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !If [EnablePI, !Ref RDSKmsKey, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: !If [EnablePI, !Ref PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      PromotionTier: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-reader
        - Key: Role
          Value: reader
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  DBClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Aurora DB cluster
    Value: !Ref DBCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterArn
  DBClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Writer endpoint address for the cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.EndpointAddress
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterEndpoint
  DBReaderEndpoint:
    Description: Reader endpoint address for the cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.ReadEndpointAddress
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBReaderEndpoint
  DBPort:
    Description: Database port
    Value: !Ref DBPort
  MasterUserSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager ARN for the master user secret managed by RDS
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-MasterUserSecretArn
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID attached to the Aurora cluster
    Value: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSecurityGroupId
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN used for cluster encryption and Performance Insights
    Value: !GetAtt RDSKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn

Conditions:
  HasAppSecurityGroup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AppSecurityGroupId, '']]
  HasAllowedIngressCidr: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AllowedIngressCidr, '']]
  PubliclyAccessibleTrue: !Equals [!Ref PubliclyAccessible, 'true']
  EnablePI: !Equals [!Ref EnablePerformanceInsights, 'true']
  DeletionProtectionTrue: !Equals [!Ref EnableDeletionProtection, 'true']
  CreateReaderInstanceCond: !Equals [!Ref CreateReaderInstance, 'true']

Resources:
  RDSKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS CMK for encrypting Aurora PostgreSQL cluster and Performance Insights
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowRDSUseOfTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub rds.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-kms-key
  RDSKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${EnvironmentName}/aurora-postgresql
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: !Sub Subnet group for ${EnvironmentName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-subnet-group

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub Security group for ${EnvironmentName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-sg

  SGIngressFromAppSG:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: HasAppSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref DBPort
      ToPort: !Ref DBPort
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroupId
      Description: Allow Postgres from application security group

  SGIngressFromCIDR:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: HasAllowedIngressCidr
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref DBPort
      ToPort: !Ref DBPort
      CidrIp: !Ref AllowedIngressCidr
      Description: Allow Postgres from specified CIDR

  DBClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Cluster parameter group for ${EnvironmentName} Aurora PostgreSQL
      Family: !Ref DBFamily
      Parameters:
        rds.force_ssl: '1'
        log_min_duration_statement: '2000'
        log_connections: '1'
        log_disconnections: '1'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-cluster-params

  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: !Ref EngineVersion
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBClusterIdentifier
      DatabaseName: !Ref DBName
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      Port: !Ref DBPort
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !Ref BackupRetentionPeriod
      PreferredBackupWindow: !Ref PreferredBackupWindow
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref DBClusterParameterGroup
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      StorageEncrypted: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      DeletionProtection: !If [DeletionProtectionTrue, true, false]
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - postgresql
      IamDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled: true
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref MinCapacityACU
        MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxCapacityACU
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-cluster
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBInstanceWriter:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${DBClusterIdentifier}-writer
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      PubliclyAccessible: !If [PubliclyAccessibleTrue, true, false]
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      AllowMajorVersionUpgrade: false
      EnablePerformanceInsights: !If [EnablePI, true, false]
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !If [EnablePI, !Ref RDSKmsKey, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: !If [EnablePI, !Ref PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      PromotionTier: 0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-writer
        - Key: Role
          Value: writer
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DBInstanceReader:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Condition: CreateReaderInstanceCond
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: !Sub ${DBClusterIdentifier}-reader
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      PubliclyAccessible: !If [PubliclyAccessibleTrue, true, false]
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      AllowMajorVersionUpgrade: false
      EnablePerformanceInsights: !If [EnablePI, true, false]
      PerformanceInsightsKMSKeyId: !If [EnablePI, !Ref RDSKmsKey, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: !If [EnablePI, !Ref PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      PromotionTier: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-aurora-reader
        - Key: Role
          Value: reader
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  DBClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the Aurora DB cluster
    Value: !Ref DBCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterArn
  DBClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Writer endpoint address for the cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.EndpointAddress
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBClusterEndpoint
  DBReaderEndpoint:
    Description: Reader endpoint address for the cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.ReadEndpointAddress
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBReaderEndpoint
  DBPort:
    Description: Database port
    Value: !Ref DBPort
  MasterUserSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager ARN for the master user secret managed by RDS
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-MasterUserSecretArn
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID attached to the Aurora cluster
    Value: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DBSecurityGroupId
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN used for cluster encryption and Performance Insights
    Value: !GetAtt RDSKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn
